info.description: Tech stack section: full-width hover rows, either paginated with a Show more/less toggle or listed in full with a CTA button

anchor.description: DOM id / URL hash for this section (e.g. "technologies" → #technologies). Lets nav links target this section on the page.

listMode.description: `showMore` = collapse the technologies behind the toggle; `none` = list every technology and use the button below instead.

showMore.description: Toggle labels + how many technologies stay visible. Used when List ending is `showMore`.

button.description: Only used when List ending is `none` — the button and the toggle are mutually exclusive

blocks.description: The technologies to list, in this order. On a Service page, leave it empty to list that service's own 'Tech stack' instead — so the section shows something before you curate it here. Picking even one technology switches that automatic list off.
